تستأجرون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْجِرُونَ (tastaʔjirūna) /tas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# تُسْتَأْجَرُونَ (tustaʔjarūna) /tus.taʔ.d͡ʒa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
